student.label: Hydrazone model compound
student.context: A hydrazone model compound (Mr 114) undergoes hydrolysis to D (58) + E (46) + F (46). Water is the reagent; use the displayed structure and masses.
student.imageAlt: Skeletal formula of the hydrazone model compound used in reaction (iii)
student.optionalPartBIntroduction: Suggest structures for the hydrolysis products using the displayed structures and relative molecular masses. Reaction (iii) uses a model compound.
avoid: Do not call the drawn compound gyromitrin or assert that it is a natural fungal toxin.
Do not label it propanone-derived in the student prompt, because that would reveal product D.

teacher.note: The retained digitised exercise labels this structure 'Gyromitrin'. The displayed structure is a propanone-derived hydrazone, CC(C)=NN(C)C=O (C5H10N2O; nominal Mr 114). This activity keeps that drawn model and its original answer slots: D is propanone (58), with methylhydrazine and methanoic acid (46 each) as E/F in either accepted order. Actual gyromitrin is the ethanal-derived compound C/C=N/N(C)C=O (PubChem CID 9548611; C4H8N2O; molar mass 100.12 g/mol). The model is not presented as actual gyromitrin or as a known natural fungal toxin.
teacher.provenanceNote: The inherited Gyromitrin label remains recorded as source metadata. This review did not recover the original paper or historical review and makes no claim about which source introduced the mismatch.
